title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Mandhan Yojana (PM-SYMY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Mandhan Yojana (PM-SYMY):

items: o Ministry: Ministry of Labor & Employment
o Objective: Provide Rs.3,000/month pension after 60 for unorganized sector workers.
o Eligibility: 	Age 18-40, income up to Rs. 15,000.
Not a member of EPFO, NPS, or income taxpayer.
o Key Points: 	Worker contributes monthly; government matches.
Ensures financial security in old age.
